text:
Maya (AE): Quick ask from FinCo during POC kickoff: they need verifiable proof that admin actions and API key rotations are logged and can be made immutable for 1 year. Can we produce something concrete for their vendor risk team in 48h?

Evan (SE): We can assemble a packet: exported audit bundle (JSONL), SHA256 manifest, forwarding config examples for Splunk HEC + syslog over TLS, and an explanation of how to achieve WORM semantics (S3 object-lock + KMS). Hosted tenants default to 90d retention, so forward/export is the way to meet 1yr.

Lina (Security): Important: bundle must include console events (policy.change, role.assign), API key.rotate, emergency-access.enable, and assume-role/admin-impersonation events. We'll redact user emails for PII unless customer requests full identifiers and an NDA is in place. We'll also sign an attestation PDF from security@redwood.com.

Claire (FinCo Sec): They specifically asked for: 1) sample console event showing role grant 2) API key rotation entry 3) sample manifest proving bundle integrity 4) a note on object-lock compliance. Splunk HEC is preferred for ingest.

Evan (SE): Example Splunk HEC push (minimal):

curl -sS https://splunk.acme.com:8088/services/collector -H 'Authorization: Splunk <HEC_TOKEN>' -d '{"event":{"ts":"2026-03-05T09:21:33Z","actor":"admin@example.com","action":"role.assign","resource":"project-finco"}}'

Evan (SE): Example redacted audit JSONL line we can include in bundle:

{"ts":"2026-03-05T09:21:33Z","actor":"REDACTED_USER","actor_id":"u-****","action":"api_key.rotate","target":"svc-payment","ip":"203.0.113.5","result":"success"}

Lina (Security): For integrity/immutability proof we'll: 1) export daily bundles to customer S3 bucket with object-lock in COMPLIANCE mode + bucket-level encryption with customer KMS key 2) produce a manifest.sha256 listing filenames and hashes 3) sign the manifest using our security PGP key and produce a PDF attestation. That combination is typically accepted by vendor-risk teams.

Maya (AE): Can you drop a short runbook for the customer on how to wire Splunk HEC from their side? They'll want the minimal steps.

Evan (SE): Yup. Runbook snippet to include: 1) create HEC token in Splunk 2) whitelist Redwood IPs or use TLS+HEC over public endpoint 3) test with one event (curl example above) 4) verify events show up in index "redwood-poc"

Evan (SE): Also adding a sample manifest entry format:

# manifest.sha256
# bundle-20260305-0001.jsonl  d2d2f9a1... (SHA256)
# bundle-20260306-0001.jsonl  7b9a4c3e...

ExportBot: export:collect started for 1797101111 - collecting audit events (range: 2026-03-01 -> 2026-03-05) ETA ~70m

Lina (Security): Note on redaction: policy v2.1 will mask user email local-part and id except when export_to_customer_flag=true. We'll document that in the bundle README and include sample before/after lines.

Claire (FinCo Sec): Also need an explicit statement that exported files are immutable once placed in their S3 with object-lock in COMPLIANCE mode. Can you add language about the legal weight of COMPLIANCE mode vs GOVERNANCE mode? Their risk team will ask.

Lina (Security): We'll include language: 'COMPLIANCE mode prevents object deletion or modification by any user, including the bucket owner, for the retention period. This is the strongest WORM guarantee supported by mainstream object stores.' We'll also reference AWS docs (or equivalent) in the attestation.

Maya (AE): Great. Timeline check: bundle + manifest + runbook + attestation PDF within 48h? I'll tell FinCo to extend their questionnaire deadline by 72h.

Evan (SE): I'll prioritize the export job and the Splunk runbook. Expect link to artifact in ~2h for first bundle slice; full 5-day collect & manifest in ~36h.

ExportBot: export:ready (1797101111/bundle-slice-2026-03-05.zip) - files: slice.jsonl (450KB), slice.sha256 - https://artifacts.internal/redwood/1797101111/bundle-slice-2026-03-05.zip

Claire (FinCo Sec): Received the slice. Looks good at a glance. Will review for presence of key rotation events.

Lina (Security): I'll draft the attestation and the redaction appendix. Attestation will state scope (hosted tenant export), time-range, what fields were redacted, and contact: security@redwood.com.

Maya (AE): Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll loop FinCo back and schedule a short walkthrough if they want a live demo of forwarding and the manifest verification process.

Evan (SE): FYI - verification CLI we include: sha256sum -c manifest.sha256  (run in directory with bundles)

ExportBot: final-bundle uploaded (1797101111/final-bundle-2026-03-06.zip) - audit.jsonl (3.9MB), manifest.sha256, README_redaction.md, attestation.pdf - https://artifacts.internal/redwood/1797101111/final-bundle-2026-03-06.zip

Claire (FinCo Sec): Confirmed receipt of final bundle and attestation. I'll feed this to our vendor-risk QA and follow up if they need more.

Maya (AE): Closing loop with customer now. Thanks everyone!
